title: SCRIPT ERROR: Compile Error: GDScript bug (please report): Native class "GDExample" not found.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.3, 4.4 and master (30bb49ec1)

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (30bb49ec1) - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (nvidia; 535.183.01) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700K CPU @ 4.20GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Consider the following setup (see MRP for details):
  - a "main_project" is a Godot project in charge of loading "mods". It searches for pck files in `user://`, then load the corresponding .gdextension file as well as the associated shared library. Then it tries to load one of the predefined tscn scenes from the pck.
 - a "mod_project"  is the Godot project exported to `user://` as a pck. This project contains the predefined scenes which depends on the `GDExample` type.
 - a C++ GDExtension declare and defines the `GDExample` type.

Now run the exported "main_project". Depending on the predefined scene an error may occur:
- With both scenes `res://gdexample_as_root.tscn` and `res://gdexample_as_child.tscn` the error `SCRIPT ERROR: Compile Error: GDScript bug (please report): Native class "GDExample" not found.` occurs. The scenes are nonetheless loaded and displayed but the error prevents the `_ready` function of the loaded scene being called (note that `[MOD] _ready` is not printed). In these scenes, the `GDExample` type appears explicitly in the scripts. These are the produced logs:
```
Vulkan 1.3.242 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070

[Main] Loading mod
[Main] Searching for *.pck in user://
[Main] Loading user://mod.pck
[Main] Searching for *.gdextension in res://bin
[Main] Loading res://bin/gdexample.gdextension
[Main] GDExample class exists
SCRIPT ERROR: Compile Error: GDScript bug (please report): Native class "GDExample" not found.
          at: GDScript::reload (res://gdexample_as_root.gd:0)
ERROR: Failed to load script "res://gdexample_as_root.gd" with error "Compilation failed".
   at: load (modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp:3022)
[Main] scene changed
```
- When loading the scene `res://gdexample_workaround.tscn` it works as expected. But this scene, the `GDExample` type is not used explicitly. These are the produced logs:
```
Vulkan 1.3.242 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070

[Main] Loading mod
[Main] Searching for *.pck in user://
[Main] Loading user://mod.pck
[Main] Searching for *.gdextension in res://bin
[Main] Loading res://bin/gdexample.gdextension
[Main] GDExample class exists
[Main] scene changed
[MOD] _ready
```
### Steps to reproduce

Download the MRP and take a look at the README file. It contains all the commands I used to build, export and deploy everything for a Linux machine. This should be easily adaptable to other platforms. It requires a godot-cpp copy.
You can change the loaded scene by editing `main.gd`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19720433/MRP.zip)
